title: Disney+ Reveals 1st Teaser Poster for Live-Action Series The Remarried Empress
content: Disney+ and Hulu unveiled the first teaser poster on Sunday for their upcoming Korean original series The Remarried Empress , based on the hit web novel and webtoon of the same name. The poster features Min-a Shin as Empress Navier, dressed in an elegant red gown inside a church.
author: ANN

title: Even the Student Council Has its Holes! Anime Casts Hiyori Kōno
content: The staff for the television anime of Muchimaro 's Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ( There is also a hole in the student organization! ) four-panel manga revealed the character promotional video, character visual, and cast for the character Tan Otori, on Saturday. Hiyori Kōno will voice the character.
author: ANN

title: 'Wareware wa Uchuujin' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, Theme Song, Main Trailer
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) of the Wareware wa Uchuujin ( We Are Aliens ) revealed an additional pair of cast, theme song, main visual (pictured right) and the main trailer on Monday. The film is scheduled to premiere in Japanese theaters on September 25.
author: MyAnimeList

title: New Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku o! ~Kono Ai Subeki Machi ni Hanei o!~ Game Streams Teaser Trailer
content: "Colorful," the 10th anniversary event for the KonoSuba – God’s blessing on this wonderful world!! anime, revealed on Sunday the teaser promotional video and key visual for Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku o! ~Kono Ai Subeki Machi ni Hanei o!~ ( KonoSuba – God’s blessing on this wonderful world!!
author: ANN

title: We Are Aliens Anime Film's Trailer Reveals 2 Cast Members, Theme Song
content: The official website for Kōhei Kadowaki and NOTHING NEW 's We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film unveiled the full trailer and a visual for the film on Monday. The trailer announces two cast members for the film, and also announces and previews the film's theme song "Sasakure" (Split) by adieu.
author: ANN

title: Visual Novel 'Senren*Banka' Gets Anime Adaptation in 2027
content: The Yuzusoft SongFes 2026 event announced an anime adaptation for its Senren*Banka visual novel on Sunday, revealing the cast members and the opening theme song artist. The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Yuzu Soft's Senren * Banka Visual Novel Gets Anime in 2027
content: Visual novel developer Yuzu Soft announced during its " Yuzu Soft Songfes 2026" event on Sunday that its Senren * Banka visual novel will have an anime adaptation that will premiere in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Best New Shonen Anime of 2026 Just Formed the Perfect New Shonen Duo
content: Black Torch , the hottest new shonen anime currently airing on Crunchyroll , is proving itself to be one of the best new shonen anime with perfect shonen elements. Every anime season introduces new series that fill the void left by classic shonen storytelling, and Summer 2026 is no exception.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece Just Set the Perfect Stage for the Death of One of Its Legendary Characters
content: One Piece is currently diving deeper into the Elbaph arc, expanding its already thrilling narrative, and it may have just set the stage for the death of a legendary character. Eiichiro Oda’s manga has earned a reputation as one of the greatest action shonen series ever created.
author: ComicBook

title: 'I Might Have Not Made It': Ichigo's Voice Actor Almost Missed His BLEACH Audition
content: In a recent interview with us here at Anime Corner, the Japanese voice actor of BLEACH protagonist Ichigo Kurosaki, Masakazu Morita, shared how he first encountered the series — and how he almost ended up not being Ichigo’s voice actor at all. Morita-san explained that he first encountered BLEACH in Shonen Jump .
author: Anime Corner
